decision.summary: MITO publishes the ODbL-licensed OpenStreetMap way as an approximate named footprint. SIPCOT's official GIS boundary is used only for transient verification because no explicit reuse licence or policy was found.

officialSource.organization: State Industries Promotion Corporation of Tamil Nadu Limited (SIPCOT)
officialSource.title: SIPCOT GIS — Siruseri industrial complex boundary
officialSource.caveat: A publicly queryable GIS service does not by itself grant MITO redistribution rights. The official coordinates are intentionally excluded from the repository and API.

comparison.method: Transient geometric comparison in EPSG:4326 with geodesic area calculations. SIPCOT coordinates were not retained after the audit.
comparison.interpretation: The open polygon is correctly associated with the named park, but its smaller area and materially different outline make it unsuitable as an exact, official, cadastral or complete boundary.

publication.displayRule: Render with dashed outline and low-opacity fill. Always display approximate and partial wording near the geometry.
publication.scopeRule: The shared park footprint locates the SIPCOT schedule only; it does not attach either rate to a particular available parcel or to the whole Siruseri registration village.
